examples.ko: 기내식으로 소고기와 생선 중에 고를 수 있어요.
examples.en: For the in-flight meal, you can choose between beef and fish.
I ate the in-flight meal on the plane and fell asleep right away.
I was surprised that the in-flight meal was tastier than I expected.
Special in-flight meals must be requested in advance.
I also requested a vegetarian in-flight meal.

examples.ko: 짧은 비행에서는 기내식 대신 간식만 줘요.
examples.en: On short flights they only give snacks instead of a meal.

explain: '기내'는 비행기 안이라는 뜻이라서 '기내식'은 비행기에서 주는 식사예요. '기내식을 먹다, 기내식이 나오다'처럼 쓰고, 비행기 안에서 파는 간식이나 음료는 보통 '기내식'이라고 하지 않아요.
explain_en: '기내' means inside the plane, so '기내식' is the meal served on a flight. You say '기내식을 먹다' or '기내식이 나오다'. Snacks or drinks sold on board are not usually called '기내식'.

examples.en: I bought a fresh octopus at the market.
An octopus has eight arms.

examples.ko: 매운 낙지볶음을 먹고 물을 많이 마셨어요.
examples.en: I ate spicy stir-fried octopus and drank a lot of water.
The octopus is wriggling on the plate.
The octopus soup is refreshing.
Both octopus and squid are sea animals.

explain: '문어', '오징어'와 비슷하게 생겼지만 서로 다른 바다 동물이에요. 한국 요리에서는 낙지볶음과 연포탕이 잘 알려져 있어요.
explain_en: It looks similar to the larger 문어 and to 오징어, but each is a different sea animal. In Korean cooking, 낙지볶음 and 연포탕 are well known.

examples.en: I blanch the spinach and toss it with sesame oil and salt.
Add the seasoning and gently toss it by hand.

examples.ko: 어머니가 배추 속에 고춧가루를 넣고 버무리고 계세요.
examples.en: Mom is mixing red pepper powder into the cabbage filling.
I toss the salad greens with dressing and eat them.

examples.ko: 오이를 소금에 절였다가 식초와 설탕에 버무렸어요.
examples.en: I salted the cucumber and then tossed it with vinegar and sugar.

examples.ko: 면을 삶은 다음 소스에 버무리면 돼요.
examples.en: Just boil the noodles and then toss them in the sauce.

explain: '섞다'보다 양념이나 소스가 골고루 묻도록 뒤적이는 느낌이에요. 나물을 양념에 섞을 때는 '무치다'도 많이 써요. 비슷하게 생긴 '얼버무리다'는 말을 분명하지 않게 할 때 쓰는 다른 단어예요.
explain_en: Compared with '섞다' (to mix), it feels like turning ingredients so that seasoning or sauce coats them evenly. For vegetable side dishes, '무치다' is also commonly used. The similar-looking '얼버무리다' is a different word meaning to speak vaguely.

examples.en: How about budae-jjigae for lunch today?
I add ramen noodles to budae-jjigae when I eat it.

examples.ko: 친구들과 부대찌개를 끓여 먹으며 이야기를 했어요.
examples.en: I talked with my friends while boiling and eating budae-jjigae.
The budae-jjigae is bubbling away.

examples.ko: 이 집 부대찌개는 국물이 칼칼해서 맛있어요.
examples.en: This restaurant's budae-jjigae has a spicy broth and tastes good.

examples.ko: 부대찌개에 햄과 소시지가 듬뿍 들어 있어요.
examples.en: The budae-jjigae is full of ham and sausage.

explain: 햄, 소시지, 김치, 라면 등을 넣고 매콤하게 끓이는 찌개예요. 큰 냄비에 끓여 같이 먹는 음식이라 친구나 가족과 먹을 때 많이 시켜요. 라면 사리나 떡 사리를 추가하기도 해요.
explain_en: It is a spicy stew made with ham, sausage, kimchi, ramen and more. Since it is boiled in a big pot and shared, people often order it when eating with friends or family. You can also add extra ramen noodles or rice cakes.

examples.en: I trim the trees in the garden on weekends.
I had my hair done at the salon yesterday.
I cleaned the fish and put it in the fridge.

examples.ko: 아버지가 손질한 칼은 아주 잘 들어요.
examples.en: The knife my father took care of cuts very well.

examples.ko: 내일 손님이 오니까 집 앞 화단을 손질할 거예요.
examples.en: A guest is coming tomorrow, so I will tidy the flower bed in front of the house.
After shaping my eyebrows, I looked in the mirror.

explain: 머리, 나무, 생선, 옷처럼 다듬거나 정리해야 하는 것에 두루 써요. 요리에서는 생선이나 채소를 씻고 자르는 준비 단계를 '손질하다'라고 해요.
explain_en: It works for anything you tidy or shape: hair, trees, fish, clothes. In cooking, it names the prep step of cleaning and cutting fish or vegetables.

examples.ko: 원두커피 전문점이 우리 동네에 새로 생겼어요.
examples.en: A new coffee shop specializing in brewed coffee opened in our neighborhood.
I brew my own coffee from beans every morning.
Brewed coffee has a stronger aroma than instant mix coffee.

examples.ko: 이 원두커피로 아이스 아메리카노를 만들어 주세요.
examples.en: Please make an iced Americano with this coffee.
How much is one cup of brewed coffee?
At the office I drink brewed coffee with milk in it.

explain: '믹스커피', '인스턴트커피'와 대비해서 원두를 갈아 내린 커피를 말해요. 카페에서 파는 커피는 보통 원두커피예요. 원두를 내리는 도구(드립, 머신)에 따라 맛이 달라져요.
explain_en: It contrasts with '믹스커피' and '인스턴트커피' and means coffee brewed from ground beans. The coffee sold at cafes is usually this kind. The taste changes depending on how it is brewed, such as drip or machine.

examples.en: Cheonggukjang has a strong smell but tastes good.
I cooked cheonggukjang stew for dinner.
I add tofu and kimchi to the cheonggukjang.

examples.ko: 청국장을 먹고 나서 창문을 열어 환기했어요.
examples.en: After eating cheonggukjang, I opened the window to air out the room.
I tried cheonggukjang for the first time and it tasted nutty.
Cheonggukjang and a bowl of rice, please.

explain: 된장찌개와 비슷하게 끓여 먹지만 냄새가 훨씬 강해서 호불호가 갈려요. 식당에서는 '청국장찌개'라고도 해요.
explain_en: It is boiled like doenjang jjigae, but the smell is much stronger, so people either love it or dislike it. In restaurants it may be called '청국장찌개'.
